[LB25] Improvements to the progress prize submission — NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning
Challenge
NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge


Solution Writeup · 25th place · Jun 17, 2026

You may have read my progress prize winning submission.

Instead of reading a lot of text first, you can look at the data and get a sense of the changes that I
have made

https://nemotron.huikang.dev/evaluation.html?logpath=06-07-03-07&problem=021ed764

Changes that I have made

   •     Fix the adapter evaluation notebook (I found out that the prompt is wrong, which caused
         the answer to not be boxed in validation but in fact it is being boxed on submission)
   •     Reduce the length of equation_numeric by half (I found out that either both inputs are
         outputs are reversed, or they are both not reversed)
   •     Training on synthetic data for cipher, unit conversion, gravity and numeral (I hope to
         guarantee 100% correctness on these problems)
   •     Training on additional synthetic data for cipher (as the Nemotron is bad at spelling, I
         added synthetic data just on the prefixes of the cipher problem)
   •     Reorganize the chain of thought for bit manipulation.

On the private leaderboard, out of 15 times my submission scored 0.872 4 times, 0.868 8 times,
0.864 3 times (could have won a solo gold if I selected the "correct" submission, but the same
can be said for many other teams).

I did not manage to make progress on cryptarithm.

   •     I discovered, 3 days before the deadline, that many problems there is one multiplication,
         one subtraction and one addition (but each of them could have an additional plus one or
         minus one)
   •     I tried to get the chain of thought to guess better than random, but apparently the LLM
         after training devolves to repeating guesses.
